signIn.title: Sign in to Jekimo
signIn.forgot: Forgot your password? Ask an instance admin for a reset link.

setup.title: Set up Jekimo
setup.intro: Create the first administrator and the first project.
setup.tokenHint: Printed in the API's log when it starts. Valid until setup completes or the API restarts.
setup.doneBody: Your first project, {project}, has an ingestion key. Configure your SDK with it.
setup.closedBody: This instance is already set up. Sign in instead.

invite.title: Accept your invitation
invite.intro: Choose a password to create your account.
invite.doneBody: Sign in with your email and new password.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password. Every session of your account will be signed out.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password.

link.missingBody: Open the full link you were given, or ask an instance admin for a new one.
